subject: Missed mutual action plan check-in — timeline update & demo reschedule
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@clearwell.ai>, Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@brightsidehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan check-in — we missed the slot this AM

Hi Olivia / Tom —

We were on for the MAP checkpoint at 8:00am PT today and it looks like the session didn’t start — I hopped in the call and Tom wasn’t available. No worries if something urgent came up, just wanted to flag the impact to our rollout timeline.

Quick notes: the MAP had the next milestones tied to the demo & integration artifacts we were expecting this week. If we push the demo back, the production target shifts by ~2 weeks unless we compress later tasks.

Can you confirm:
- whether you’d like to reschedule the checkpoint this week or next
- whether any milestones in the MAP should move (I included an attachment with a 1-column change proposal)

Attaching the latest MAP and a proposed demo agenda for the reschedule. If you prefer, we can send a short revised timeline and circulate a new calendar invite.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_MAP_v3.xlsx (Excel, 34 KB), proposed-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@clearwell.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@brightsidehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan check-in — we missed the slot this AM

Hi Ben —

So sorry — Tom was pulled into a last-minute leadership call and couldn’t make it. Completely my fault for not flagging earlier. We appreciate the heads up on the timeline implications.

We can do either:
- Wednesday 7/22 at 9:30am PT
- Thursday 7/23 at 11:00am PT

Tom and I reviewed the MAP attachment and we think shifting the demo by one week is reasonable. That would move the production target by one week as well; we should still hit the Q3 milestone window you showed, assuming no further delays.

Monica — looping you in to confirm if that timeline shift causes any concerns from the integration side.

Thanks and apologies again —
Olivia
Director of Product Partnerships | Clearwell AI
olivia.park@clearwell.ai | +1 (206) 555-0133

Thanks Olivia — appreciate the quick reply.

Let’s lock Wednesday 7/22 at 9:30am PT. I’ve updated the MAP to reflect a +1 week shift for the demo milestone and added two contingency actions to avoid cascading delays (see RDW_MAP_v3.xlsx, tab "adjusted-timeline").

Planned agenda for the rescheduled session:
- 9:30–9:45: Quick alignment on objectives and success criteria (owners confirmed)
- 9:45–10:15: Live demo + integration Q&A
- 10:15–10:30: Action items and next steps (owners + dates in MAP)

Tom — would you like the demo to focus on the production workflow or the API integration first? We can tailor the agenda.

I’ll send a calendar invite in a minute and attach the updated MAP and agenda here again.

Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Flag for Ben/Monica: Tom asked earlier whether we should demonstrate the production workflow first; I recommend starting with the API integration (10–15 mins) so Brightside’s engineers can validate endpoint behavior early, then switch to a short UX-driven end-to-end run.

See you all Wednesday.
